_meta.title: TradingView logging-only webhook payload template
_meta.status: PROPOSED — not yet configured in TradingView; do not treat placeholders as confirmed
_meta.purpose: Observation/evidence only. Contains NO broker instruction, NO API keys, NO secrets.
notes: TradingView placeholders use the {{...}} syntax and are substituted by TradingView at fire time.
Placeholders marked TO_VERIFY have NOT been confirmed against the live Farouk Playbook alert setup and must be checked in Stage 1/2 before relying on them.
The shared secret/token is NOT in this body — it lives in the endpoint path and/or an HTTP header (see safety spec).

If a placeholder is unsupported for a given alert, leave the field out rather than sending a literal unresolved {{...}} string; the receiver treats an unresolved {{...}} as parse_status=UNRESOLVED_PLACEHOLDER.

alert_name: LIVE001_<ALERT_NAME>  (TO_VERIFY: TradingView has no generic {{alert_name}} placeholder; the identifying name is hardcoded per-alert in the message, mirroring the alert's own Name)
chart_interval: {{interval}}  (same source as timeframe; kept as an explicit field for clarity)
event_text: <hardcoded per-alert descriptive text, e.g. 'A+ or better setup' or 'Farouks Playbook: A+ LONG on XAUUSD 3'>
trigger_price: {{close}}  (TO_VERIFY: {{close}} is the common bar-close placeholder; confirm it reflects the intended trigger price for THIS indicator alert, not a delayed value)
trigger_time: {{time}}  (TO_VERIFY: confirm whether {{time}} is the bar-open/bar-close time and its timezone; the exported CSV used UTC 'Z' timestamps — reconcile format at Stage 3)
server_time_hint: {{timenow}}  (TO_VERIFY: {{timenow}} is the alert firing time; confirm format/timezone)
direction: <OPTIONAL, hardcoded per-alert if the alert is directional: LONG | SHORT | NA>
grade: <OPTIONAL, hardcoded per-alert if applicable: A | A+ | NA (A+++ has never been observed)>
event_type: <OPTIONAL, hardcoded per-alert: A_PLUS | SWEEP_HIGH | SWEEP_LOW | CHOCH_UP | CHOCH_DOWN | ENGULFING | BPR_TAPPED | ANY_ALERT | ...>
schema_nonce: <OPTIONAL static or per-alert constant to help dedupe/version; TradingView cannot generate a random nonce, so this is a STATIC schema tag, not a security nonce (TO_VERIFY if any {{...}} unique id exists)>
